intelligence_strip.grain: As of 2026-08-31; 2,115 listed rows across 13 company types, never summed; 72 placeholder-NAIC reinsurer/captive rows are not identities. Activity events, company actions and examinations are separate. Agency and producer bulk not acquired.

One HFC facility class (July 2026 bed report; 36,730 licensed beds). 331 ACLFs, 39 RHAs, county Home Health/Hospice lists and CMS (303/128/61) stay separate. Proven exact state-to-CMS bridges: 0, which is not zero overlap.

State registration only (IAPD 2026-09-17). 38 ERA, 2,685 notice filings and 264 principal-office firms are separate lenses. 273 Consent Order and 52 Cease and Desist listings are separate archives; 3 exact firm-CRD links.

what_makes_tennessee_different: Move: Tennessee Revenue grants Intrastate Authority but publishes no roster or search, and the household-goods consumer rule was repealed effective 2026-03-09.
Lender: TDFI regulates mortgage lenders, brokers, servicers and MLOs but publishes no bulk license file; NMLS Consumer Access is the verification path.
Contractor: the $25,000 Contractor license is one of four credentials; Home Improvement applies only in nine counties, and LLE/LLP only where the state Fire Prevention division inspects.
Insurance: TDCI publishes a NAIC-keyed licensed-company list plus separate activity, action and examination records.
Senior: HFC (consolidated July 1, 2024) licenses Nursing Homes, Assisted Care Living Facilities and Residential Homes for the Aged as separate classes beside CMS.
Investor: state IA, ERA, notice and principal-office lenses come from IAPD; the Securities Division keeps Consent and Cease and Desist Orders as separate archives.

They cannot be summed into Tennessee businesses, providers, licensed professionals, or Trust Hub records.
